prompt: A steady, slightly soft frame from a phone leaned on the lip of a bathtub, looking at a calm, kind man in his fifties with a weathered face and a grey stubble jaw, wearing faded blue overalls, kneeling on a tiled floor beside a basin, one hand resting on a copper pipe under it, eyes aimed warmly at the lens, mouth mid-sentence. A window with frosted glass pours flat daylight across the room and bleaches the tiles behind him. A toolbag sits open at his knee, and nothing is written on the picture. Thanks.
